name: Pilgrimage and Fieldwork
status: Verified public release. Primary pickup/XR, Goldwind, two-chapter campaign and interface journeys passed. Legacy audio recovery also passed. Physical-device and human-experience gates remain open.
concurrentWork: Comparisons from the gameplay release through the checked master found no intervening Vesperfall changes. Dino Atlas, Leonardo's Guild, Aether Reach and other sibling changes are preserved. Closure adds only four tested legacy harness updates and nested evidence records.

primaryPublic.scope: Actual public HTTPS and production WebGL. Source gate and post-journey byte checks passed. All recorded JavaScript error arrays are empty; captured console/shader arrays are empty where collected.

firstBellLessons.scope: All ten lessons and lesson preservation; not a new full boss-combat certification.

resonantInitial.reason: Harness assumed audio controls remained on page four after Goldwind settings enlarged the menu. The real controls were on page five; no captured runtime errors.

audioRecovery.repair: Test-only bounded controller navigation now finds the actual audio page, records all five visited pages, changes the real music bus and exits. Original action outcomes remain, with an additional console-error assertion. No production code or actor state was changed.

independentAudit: Recomputed all 11 retained ZIP hashes. Every release-era source archive matches the same 99-file production manifest; source revisions and empty uncommitted diffs were checked. The older failed checkpoint diagnostic is explicitly a different pre-repair source. Full reports, screenshots, hashes and failed traces are retained in the downloadable evidence bundle. GitHub artifacts expire after their recorded retention periods.

saveFailure.reason: A transient near-miss soundPassed flag on a hostile bolt failed strict checkpoint validation, leaving a previous checkpoint. Capture now strips exactly that audio-only field while preserving projectile physics and rejecting unknown gameplay fields. The successful campaign test requires saved full current state before reload, not just recovery of an older checkpoint.

implemented: Grip-first near collection by either tracked controller, aimed draw-hand grip pull, explicit cancellation and gain feedback; body-height and line-of-sight contact collection after walking or teleporting; two seeded authored-module chapter families, Lantern Causeway and Ashen Archive; headset Missions access to new and original content; first-person VR and a separate playable AR expedition preserving ordinary progress. Goldwind remains default with approved golden-arrow input.
generationBoundary: Each chapter family has two authored module variants, with separate seeded geometry, encounter, supply and decoration streams. Routes, shutters, relay shots and service returns have gameplay purposes. This is a bounded initial two-chapter catalogue, followed by retained Endless, not a finished AAA campaign or measured human play-duration claim.
preservation: Five layout readers remain: hollow-dominions-1, returning-bell-1, returning-bell-2, lantern-causeway-1 and ashen-archive-1. Existing profile/envelope keys, rewards, saved Classic/Manual settings, Xbox down-Blink/left-damage shortcuts and hand-pinch menus remain. Continuing old saves restores their recorded geography. Canonical 76-task/six-sheet planning remains synchronized; no human gates were fabricated.
evidenceLimits: Generated keyboard/gamepad events and simulated WebXR poses/joints exercised production gameplay without assigning player positions, enemy health, resources or objectives. Physical Quest 3/Xbox, real tracking, passthrough clarity, seated/standing ergonomics, sustained performance, comfort, unfamiliar/repeat-player comprehension and final biome art remain unverified. AR Sanctuary and Architect's Table remain distinct stationary/paused modes. AR expedition does not scan furniture, anchor geometry to physical surfaces or make virtual floors safe physical support. Bare hands operate menus, not archery.
localRecovery: Nine targeted model tests and workbook validation passed locally. A local full-suite attempt exceeded a 20-second process budget and is retained as incomplete, not a pass. Direct web-tool/public-site DNS access was unavailable in this runtime; public HTTP/browser evidence comes from the identified successful Actions jobs.
nextOpportunity: Use the owner's next headset playtest to verify actual grip acquisition and old/new mission access, then assess whether the two chapters provide readable, sufficiently substantial exploration and learned alternate routes. Do not override player reports with aggregate test counts.
closureScope: Four legacy browser-test updates and nested publication receipts only. No live gameplay, save, geometry, asset, default, release metadata or workbook changes. No historical write-enabled staging workflows enter master.
